archive: git clone https://github.com/fluffos/xkx100 (commit ee022c90aabbbed6413acc6e10254e5a00f511fd, cloned 2026-09-05); repo root is the mudlib -- already UTF-8 upstream. MudRen/xkx100 is the same tree with a MudCore wrap and was not converted separately
name: 侠客行一百
english_description: A UTF-8 FluffOS modernization of 侠客行一百 (Coollizard & xkx100, 2003-2004), from github.com/fluffos/xkx100. Same game as this collection's xkx100 (the Coollizard rar) but a different snapshot: 12192 files, master at /adm/single/master, already-UTF-8 is_chinese via PCRE Han. New characters pick a hometown region (1-5; city is random), allocate 80 attribute points, and choose a personality, then land in that city's inn. In-game text is Chinese (look/score/quit). Admin is a standard wizlist file. No MySQL required.
